card.name: Political talk about helping American families
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected 'families' or 'people' in political or advocacy text, such as 'Families and', 'Supporting', 'help', 'American' and 'providing'. Mostly energy-policy and government-benefit slogans.

modes.label: Slogan headings
modes.description: Words in benefit-style headlines about serving families, businesses or communities.
modes.example: Supplying America’s Families<< and>> Businesses with American Energy

modes.label: Helping verbs and 'American'
modes.description: Verbs or 'American' that lead into who benefits, such as people, jobs or families.
modes.example: so why force them on the<< American>> people?”

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward 'families', 'households' and 'homes'.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up a mention of families or ordinary people who benefit from a policy.
